{{Quote|This is not an official order, but rather a simple reconnaissance assignment. We're concerned about one of our agents stationed on Yavin IV. I'll give you some more details if you take the assignment. Do you accept?|Harmon Vintollo, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Harmon Vintollo''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was stationed at [[Kaadara]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and oversaw an operation at the [[Geonosian Bio-Lab]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Harmon Vintollo appeared as a non-player character in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
